title: [Main] Item tracking validation when lot numbers are assigned concerns the warehouse pick level rather than at the sales order levelInitial Commit
summary: Fixes a bug where item tracking validation for assigned lot numbers was evaluated at the warehouse pick level instead of at the sales order level. Logic was added to the Item Tracking Data Collection codeunit, with new tests in the W1 and RU SCM item tracking test codeunits.
key_points: Fixes bug 646429 on item tracking validation for assigned lot numbers
Validation previously considered the warehouse pick level rather than the sales order level
New logic added to codeunit 6501 Item Tracking Data Collection
Regression tests added to the W1 and RU SCM Item Tracking test codeunits
quote: Item tracking validation when lot numbers are assigned concerns the warehouse pick level rather than at the sales order level
